gloss: express bus; highway bus; long-distance bus

definitions.gloss: express bus; highway bus; long-distance bus
definitions.explanation: A bus that travels on expressways, connecting cities or distant areas. A common and affordable alternative to trains for intercity travel in Japan.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}バスで{大阪|おおさか}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go to Osaka by express bus.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}バスは{新幹線|しんかんせん}より{安|やす}い。
examples.english: The express bus is cheaper than the bullet train.

examples.japanese: {夜行|やこう}{高速|こうそく}バスに{乗|の}れば、{朝|あさ}には{目的地|もくてきち}に{着|つ}く。
examples.english: If you take an overnight express bus, you'll arrive at your destination by morning.

notes:
Composed of {高速|こうそく} (high speed; expressway) + バス (bus). Refers to buses that travel on expressways ({高速道路|こうそくどうろ}) for intercity transport.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高速|こうそく}バスに{乗|の}る: to ride an express bus
- {高速|こうそく}バスを{予約|よやく}する: to book an express bus
- {夜行|やこう}{高速|こうそく}バス: overnight express bus
- {高速|こうそく}バスの{乗|の}り{場|ば}: express bus stop/terminal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {路線|ろせん}バス: local route bus — operates within a city
- {貸切|かしきり}バス: chartered bus — rented for group travel
- {夜行|やこう}バス: overnight bus — a subcategory of {高速|こうそく}バス

CULTURAL NOTE:
Express buses are a budget-friendly way to travel between Japanese cities. Popular routes include Tokyo-Osaka and Tokyo-Nagoya. Overnight buses ({夜行|やこう}バス) are especially popular among students and budget travelers, as they save on hotel costs.
